title: This black box doesn't hide your secret
audienceHypothesis: People who share PDFs at work and enjoy quick, surprising software demonstrations.
format: Immediate contradiction, original experiment, early reveal, mechanism, fix, repeat test, shareable takeaway.
purpose: Audience discovery and format validation. No affiliate offer is included; this short is not designed for TikTok Creator Rewards.

beats.text: This black box is lying to you.
beats.caption: THIS BLACK BOX IS LYING

beats.text: I covered a fake PIN in this PDF. Looks hidden, right?
beats.caption: LOOKS HIDDEN. RIGHT?

beats.text: There it is. Four, eight, two, seven.
beats.caption: 4827. STILL IN THE FILE.

beats.text: The rectangle covered the pixels. The PDF still had the words.
beats.caption: THE TEXT WAS STILL THERE

beats.text: Your secret just got a curtain.
beats.caption: YOUR SECRET GOT A CURTAIN

beats.text: Now I use real redaction, apply it, and save a fresh copy.
beats.caption: REDACT. APPLY. SAVE.

beats.text: Extract the text again. The PIN is gone.
beats.caption: THIS TIME: PIN REMOVED

beats.text: Before sharing a sensitive PDF, check the exported file. Remove hidden information, too.
beats.caption: CHECK THE EXPORTED FILE

beats.text: Send this to your black box friend.
beats.caption: SEND THIS TO YOUR BLACK BOX FRIEND
